fundamentals.csv — point-in-time company fundamentals

Copy fundamentals_template.csv → fundamentals.csv and fill rows.
Add multiple rows per ticker (FY / H1) with real publish_date.

Columns:
  stock_code     NSE ticker
  report_date    Period end (YYYY-MM-DD)
  publish_date   When the print was knowable (preferred as-of)
  eps            Earnings per share
  dividend       DPS for the period
  book_value     Book value per share
  period         e.g. FY2023, H1-2024, FY2025
  pat            Profit after tax (KES bn) — banks
  pat_yoy        PAT year-over-year % — banks
  roe            Return on equity % — banks
  roa            Return on assets % — banks
  nim            Net interest margin % — banks
  cir            Cost-to-income ratio % — banks
  npl            Non-performing loan ratio % — banks
  assets         Total assets (KES bn) — banks
  loans          Net loans (KES bn) — banks
  deposits       Customer deposits (KES bn) — banks
  nii            Net interest income (KES bn) — banks
  nfi            Non-funded / non-interest income (KES bn) — banks

Bank FY seed source (no live scrape):
  Primary: kenyanbanks.com FY2025 dashboard (balance sheet, income, ROE/ROA/NIM/CIR/PAT).
  Secondary gap fills: Cytonn FY'2025 listed-banks report (NPL blanks; HFCK NPL)
    and ApexHub listed FY'2025 for HFCK ROE/ROA/NIM/CIR/EPS/DPS.
  EPS left blank when kenyanbanks omitted it and secondary prints conflict.
  HFCK FY2025 assets/deposits are kenyanbanks estimates (~); other HF fields partial.

Rewrite via: python scripts/_seed_bank_fundamentals.py

Leakage: models join on publish_date (fallback report_date) backward to trade_date.
Features included only if coverage ≥ 30% of train rows.
Do not invent EPS — leave blank until official filings are entered.
